title: WOW Routines overnight master plan
goal: Portal at top quality by morning: every active routine has unique on-style art, locked avatars, gesture framing, matching objects/actions.
non_negotiables: Illustration only: flat 2D, thin black outlines, muted flat colours
PURE WHITE background; no grey frame; no inner vignette box
NO text, logos, PixtoLearn, WOW, captions, watermarks on art
One PRIMARY avatar + locked outfit per routine; never mix ages/genders mid-pack
Accent colour highlights the action or hero object (design-system.json)
UNIQUE art per card: never reuse cover as an action; never duplicate hashes inside a pack
Objects must match action style (same outline language and palette family)
Framing: cover = full/3/4 recognition; objects = single object; hygiene face/hands = close-up; garments = zone crop; body steps = 3/4 when posture teaches
Clothes = two packs only: clothes-boy (C1) and clothes-girl (C2); objects once; dress actions then undress actions
Gender-split when clinical garments differ (already done for clothes)

avatar_locks.C1: child boy - shower, toilet-boy, road, museum, cycling, swimming, clothes-boy
avatar_locks.C2: child girl - brushing-teeth, toilet-girl, beach, theme-park, mall, tennis, clothes-girl
avatar_locks.T1: teen boy - plane, train, taxi, hotel, supermarket, airport, gym, camping, holidays, mountain, sport-event
avatar_locks.T2: teen girl - ferry, bus, tube, haircare, nail-care, hiking
avatar_locks.YA1: young-adult woman - period, intimate-female, hospital, hairdresser
avatar_locks.YA2: young-adult man - intimate-male, shaving, foot-care, pharmacy
avatar_locks.E1: gender-neutral youth - all emotion packs + emotions-hub

No same-pack MD5 duplicates among needed cards
No scrub-notch hits on needed cards
